qualification.reason: The document is an Expression of Interest issued by the Ohio Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (OhioMHAS) for Recovery Month Events funding. It includes a clear procurement intent, issuing organization, scope of work, eligibility requirements, funding amount, deadlines, and application instructions, making it a valid procurement opportunity for analysis.

quotes.quote: Recovery Month Events – Expression of Interest (EOI)
Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT

OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.
Each eligible organization may request up to $10,000 to plan and implement activities and event(s)
All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025.

findings.title: RFA Posting Date
findings.fact: The Request for Applications is posted on 07/11/2025.
findings.business_implication: The application window is short, giving bidders only 14 days to prepare and submit a response.
findings.action_recommendation: Begin preparation immediately, allocate resources, and prioritize completing the application well before the deadline.

findings.title: RFA Due Date and Time
findings.fact: The Request for Applications is due on 07/25/2025 by 3 p.m. EDT.
findings.business_implication: Strict deadline; late submissions will likely be rejected, risking loss of funding opportunity.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit well before the deadline to avoid technical issues; set internal deadline earlier and confirm submission receipt.

findings.title: Non-Profit Status Requirement
findings.fact: The organization must be a 501(c)(3) non-profit, which may affect eligibility and liability.
findings.business_implication: Only 501(c)(3) non-profits are eligible; if the bidder does not have this status, they cannot apply, and if they do, they must ensure compliance with IRS regulations.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify 501(c)(3) status and have documentation ready; if not eligible, consider partnering with an eligible organization or seek fiscal sponsorship.

findings.title: Expenditure Deadline
findings.fact: All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025, creating a deadline that could impact financial exposure if not met.
findings.business_implication: Failure to expend funds by the deadline may result in clawback or loss of funds, and could harm the organization's reputation and future funding prospects.
findings.action_recommendation: Develop a detailed spending plan and timeline to ensure full expenditure by the deadline; monitor progress regularly and adjust plans as needed.
